body.en:
Nominal mix uses a prescribed proportion under permitted grade and project conditions. It is not a substitute for control of actual materials, free water, compaction or curing. A common teaching example is M20 nominal 1:1.5:3 by volume, but this does not guarantee M20 strength for arbitrary materials. Refer to applicable IS 456 provisions; design mix is required where specified.

Design mix uses tested material properties and trials to select proportions meeting strength, workability, durability and economy. Grades M10–M20 are ordinarily classified as ordinary concrete and M25–M55 as standard concrete in IS 456; use the applicable edition. Mix ratios are usually expressed by mass relative to cementitious material and must state water and admixture basis.
body.gu:
Nominal mix માં મંજૂર grade અને project conditions હેઠળ નિર્ધારિત proportion વપરાય છે. વાસ્તવિક materials, free water, compaction અને curing નું control તેના વગર પણ જરૂરી છે. શિક્ષણમાં M20 nominal 1:1.5:3 volume ratio ઉદાહરણરૂપ છે, પરંતુ કોઈપણ materials માં તે M20 strength ની ખાતરી નથી. લાગુ IS 456 provisions જુઓ; જ્યાં જરૂરી હોય ત્યાં design mix વાપરો.

Design mix માં tested material properties અને trials વડે strength, workability, durability તથા economy સંતોષતા proportions પસંદ થાય છે. IS 456 માં સામાન્ય રીતે M10–M20 ordinary અને M25–M55 standard concrete કહેવાય છે; લાગુ edition તપાસો. Mix ratio સામાન્ય રીતે cementitious material ના mass આધારિત હોય છે અને water તથા admixture નો આધાર સ્પષ્ટ કરવો.

h.gu: 4.2 Mix design નું મહત્વ અને inputs

body.en: Mix design aims to meet specified characteristic strength, placing workability and exposure durability with consistent, economical production. Specify grade, exposure, maximum nominal aggregate size, grading, slump, placement method, cement and supplementary materials, admixture compatibility, quality control, and aggregate specific gravity and absorption. Durability limits on maximum free water–cement ratio and minimum cementitious content come from the applicable exposure code, not strength alone. Pumping, congested reinforcement and weather may change required workability and adjustments.
body.gu: Mix design નો હેતુ નિર્ધારિત characteristic strength, placing workability અને exposure durability ને સાતત્યપૂર્ણ તથા આર્થિક production સાથે મેળવવાનો છે. Grade, exposure, maximum nominal aggregate size, grading, slump, placing method, cement અને supplementary materials, admixture compatibility, quality control અને aggregate specific gravity તથા absorption નિર્ધારિત કરો. Maximum free water–cement ratio અને minimum cementitious content ની durability limits લાગુ exposure code થી આવે છે; માત્ર strength પરથી નહીં. Pumping, congested reinforcement અને weather થી workability તથા adjustments બદલાય શકે.

items.syllabus_item: 4.3 different methods of mix design and suitability

body.en: IS 10262 gives Indian guidance using target strength, empirical inputs and absolute-volume proportioning verified by trials. Other established approaches include ACI and DOE methods; each uses its own assumptions, tables, material definitions, units and scope. Use the method specified by the project and local code rather than mixing unexamined tables from different methods. All methods require representative test data and laboratory/site trials.
body.gu: IS 10262 માં target strength, empirical inputs અને absolute-volume proportioning સાથે trial verification નો ભારતીય અભિગમ છે. ACI અને DOE પણ સ્થાપિત methods છે; તેમની assumptions, tables, material definitions, units અને scope જુદા છે. Project અને local code માં નિર્ધારિત method વાપરો; જુદી methods ના tables તપાસ વગર ભેળવો નહીં. દરેક method માટે representative test data તથા laboratory/site trials જરૂરી છે.

items.syllabus_item: 4.4 concrete mix design as per IS 10262

body.en:
1. Target: for IS 10262:2019 calculate both fck + 1.65S and fck + X and adopt the higher. S is established or permitted assumed standard deviation; X is the grade-based margin. 2. Water–cement ratio: choose from strength information and trial experience; it must not exceed the applicable durability limit. 3. Water: select starting water for nominal aggregate size and reference workability, then adjust for required slump, shape and the verified water reduction of the admixture.

4. Cementitious content: divide free water by selected w/c or w/b, then check minimum and maximum applicable content and binder restrictions. 5. Aggregates: choose coarse aggregate volume fraction for grading, size and water–cement ratio, with applicable adjustments for pumping; compute available aggregate absolute volume after subtracting cement, water, admixture and entrapped air from 1 m³. Divide aggregate volume into coarse and fine portions and multiply by their specific gravities and water density.

6. Moisture corrections and trials: convert SSD design masses to field batch masses using measured absorption and moisture, and adjust added water for free moisture. Make laboratory trials, measure slump, density and strength, revise proportions, then conduct field trials. Values are not a production recipe until all specified strength, workability and durability requirements are demonstrated. Use the current standard and amendments.
body.gu:
1. Target: IS 10262:2019 મુજબ fck + 1.65S અને fck + X બંને ગણો અને વધુ કિંમત લો. S સ્થાપિત અથવા મંજૂર assumed standard deviation છે; X grade આધારિત margin છે. 2. Water–cement ratio: Strength માહિતી અને trial experience પરથી પસંદ કરો; લાગુ durability limit કરતાં વધુ ન હોવો જોઈએ. 3. Water: Nominal aggregate size અને reference workability માટેનું starting water લો; જરૂરી slump, shape અને admixture ની ચકાસેલ water reduction પ્રમાણે સુધારો.

4. Cementitious content: Free water ને પસંદ કરેલ w/c અથવા w/b થી ભાગો; લાગુ minimum તથા maximum content અને binder restrictions તપાસો. 5. Aggregates: Grading, size અને water–cement ratio માટે coarse aggregate volume fraction લો અને pumping માટે લાગુ adjustment કરો; 1 m³ માંથી cement, water, admixture અને entrapped air ના absolute volumes બાદ કરી aggregate volume શોધો. તેને coarse તથા fine માં વહેંચી specific gravity અને water density થી mass શોધો.

6. Moisture corrections અને trials: માપેલ absorption તથા moisture વડે SSD design masses ને field batch masses માં ફેરવો અને free moisture પ્રમાણે added water સુધારો. Laboratory trials માં slump, density અને strength માપી proportions સુધારો; પછી field trials કરો. જરૂરી strength, workability અને durability સાબિત ન થાય ત્યાં સુધી આ production recipe નથી. Current standard તથા amendments વાપરો.

items.syllabus_item: 4.5 IS examples for ordinary and standard grade without and with admixture

body.en:
Absolute volume of an ingredient equals its mass divided by its specific gravity and water density. The 1 m³ sum includes entrapped air and the volume of liquid admixture when supplied. Aggregate mass calculations are on the declared moisture basis, commonly SSD. A water-reducing admixture can reduce required free water at the same workability, but its actual reduction and compatibility must be established by trial; its liquid volume and solids basis must not be silently ignored. If the binder has several constituents, calculate their volumes separately and use the correct water–binder ratio.

For moist aggregate, free moisture is water above the SSD condition. Add it to the effective-water balance and subtract it from batch water; adjust aggregate delivery mass consistently. An aggregate drier than SSD can absorb water, requiring the opposite correction. Illustrative examples in Numericals show M20 without admixture and M30 with admixture using declared inputs; they are not universal code-prescribed mixes.
body.gu:
Ingredient નું absolute volume = તેનું mass / (specific gravity × water density). 1 m³ ના સરવાળામાં entrapped air અને liquid admixture આપવામાં આવેલ હોય તો તેનો volume પણ ઉમેરો. Aggregate mass દર્શાવેલ moisture basis, સામાન્ય રીતે SSD, પર ગણો. Water-reducing admixture સમાન workability પર free water ઘટાડી શકે છે, પરંતુ વાસ્તવિક reduction અને compatibility trial થી સાબિત કરો; liquid volume અને solids basis અવગણશો નહીં. ઘણા binder constituents હોય તો દરેકનું volume અલગ ગણો અને યોગ્ય water–binder ratio વાપરો.

Moist aggregate માં SSD condition કરતાં વધારાનું water એટલે free moisture. તેને effective-water balance માં ઉમેરો અને batch water માંથી બાદ કરો; aggregate delivery mass ને પણ અનુકૂળ સુધારો. SSD કરતાં સૂકો aggregate પાણી શોષી શકે છે, તેથી વિરુદ્ધ correction જરૂરી છે. Numericals માં જાહેર assumptions સાથે M20 વગર admixture અને M30 સાથે admixture ના શૈક્ષણિક દાખલા છે; તે સાર્વત્રિક code-prescribed mixes નથી.

title.en: Numerical 4.1 — M20 trial mix without admixture
title.gu: Numerical 4.1 — Admixture વગર M20 trial mix

body.en:
Given: For 1 m³, use SSD aggregates, cement SG 3.15, fine aggregate SG 2.65, coarse aggregate SG 2.70, entrapped air 1% and coarse fraction 0.62 of aggregate absolute volume. Water density = 1000 kg/m³. These are declared teaching inputs; verify actual code tables, exposure limits and trials. M20: S = 4 MPa, X = 5.5 MPa; adopt w/c = 0.50 and water 180 kg. No admixture.

Step 1. Calculate both target-strength alternatives.

fck + 1.65S = 20 + 1.65 × 4fck + 1.65S = 26.6 MPafck + X = 20 + 5.5fck + X = 25.5 MPaTarget strength = 26.6 MPa

Step 2. Calculate cement content; check against the project durability limits.

Cement = water / (w/c)Cement = 180 / 0.50Cement = 360 kg

Step 3. Find remaining aggregate volume after cement, water and air.

Vagg = 1 − Vcement − Vwater − VairVagg = 1 − 360/3150 − 180/1000 − 0.01Vagg = 0.695714 m³

Step 4. Convert coarse and fine absolute volumes to SSD masses.

Coarse = 0.695714 × 0.62 × 2700Coarse ≈ 1165 kgFine = 0.695714 × 0.38 × 2650Fine ≈ 701 kg

Final answer:

Per m³ SSD: cement 360 kg, water 180 kg, fine aggregate 701 kg, coarse aggregate 1165 kg. Trial and durability checks required.

title.en: Numerical 4.2 — M30 trial mix with admixture
title.gu: Numerical 4.2 — Admixture સાથે M30 trial mix

body.en:
Given: For 1 m³, use SSD aggregates, cement SG 3.15, fine aggregate SG 2.65, coarse aggregate SG 2.70, entrapped air 1% and coarse fraction 0.62 of aggregate absolute volume. Water density = 1000 kg/m³. These are declared teaching inputs; verify actual code tables, exposure limits and trials. M30: S = 5 MPa, X = 6.5 MPa; adopt w/c = 0.40, water 160 kg after verified reduction, and liquid admixture 4 kg with SG 1.10.

Step 1. Calculate both target-strength alternatives.

fck + 1.65S = 30 + 1.65 × 5fck + 1.65S = 38.25 MPafck + X = 30 + 6.5fck + X = 36.5 MPaTarget strength = 38.25 MPa

Step 2. Calculate cement and liquid admixture volume.

Cement = 160 / 0.40Cement = 400 kgVadmixture = 4 / 1100Vadmixture = 0.003636 m³

Step 3. Calculate aggregate volume including admixture volume.

Vagg = 1 − Vcement − Vwater − Vadmixture − VairVagg = 1 − 400/3150 − 160/1000 − 4/1100 − 0.01Vagg = 0.699380 m³

Step 4. Find coarse and fine SSD masses.

Coarse = 0.699380 × 0.62 × 2700Coarse ≈ 1171 kgFine = 0.699380 × 0.38 × 2650Fine ≈ 704 kg

Final answer:

Per m³ SSD: cement 400 kg, water 160 kg, admixture 4 kg, fine aggregate 704 kg, coarse aggregate 1171 kg. Trial and durability checks required.

title.gu: Numerical 4.3 — Free moisture batch correction ની ગણતરી

body.en:
Given: SSD aggregate mass is 1000 kg. Measured free surface moisture is 2% of SSD mass. Required effective water is 180 kg. Find wet aggregate and added water, assuming no other correction.

Step 1. Find free water.

Free water = 1000 × 0.02Free water = 20 kg

Step 2. Adjust wet aggregate and added water.

Wet aggregate = 1000 + 20Added water = 180 − 20

Final answer:

Wet aggregate = 1020 kg; added water = 160 kg.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: SSD aggregate mass 1000 kg છે. Measured free surface moisture SSD mass ના 2% છે. Required effective water 180 kg છે. અન્ય correction ન હોય તો wet aggregate અને added water શોધો.

Step 1. Free water શોધો.

Free water = 1000 × 0.02Free water = 20 kg

Step 2. Wet aggregate અને added water સુધારો.

Wet aggregate = 1000 + 20Added water = 180 − 20

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Wet aggregate = 1020 kg; ઉમેરવાનું water = 160 kg.
